changes.author: Ada
changes.text: Add that doors open at 10:00.

changes.author: Bo
changes.text: Add that tickets stop at 17:00.

policy: Preserve both compatible opening-hour details.
rubric: The final text includes both times and preserves Saturday opening.

changes.author: Ada
changes.text: The gallery is closed this Saturday.

changes.author: Bo
changes.text: Keep the gallery open this Saturday for a special exhibit.

policy: Do not silently choose between incompatible event claims.
rubric: Expose the conflicting open and closed intentions with their update IDs.

changes.author: Ada
changes.text: Add three newly arrived visitors.

changes.author: Bo
changes.text: Add four other newly arrived visitors.

policy: Combine independent additions when they clearly count distinct arrivals.
rubric: The result is 17 visitors, with both update IDs applied.

changes.author: Ada
changes.text: The tally was wrong; the correct total is 12 visitors.

changes.author: Bo
changes.text: Add two more visitors to the tally.

policy: Do not guess whether the correction included the two new arrivals.
rubric: Expose whether the corrected total precedes or includes the additional two visitors.

changes.author: Ada
changes.text: Add blue to the color collection.

changes.author: Bo
changes.text: Add green to the color collection.

policy: Keep distinct additions.
rubric: Members include red, blue and green exactly once.

changes.author: Ada
changes.text: Remove red; it is obsolete.

changes.author: Bo
changes.text: Keep red in the collection; we still use it.

policy: Conflicting membership intentions require an alternative.
rubric: Do not claim both incompatible membership decisions were applied.

changes.author: Ada
changes.text: Change owner to Bo.

changes.author: Bo
changes.text: Change region to east.

policy: Retain compatible edits to separate fields.
rubric: Owner is Bo and region is east; both IDs are applied.

changes.author: Ada
changes.text: Rename contact to primary_contact and keep Ada.

changes.author: Bo
changes.text: Replace contact with Bo; keep its old key.

policy: Do not duplicate one logical contact or silently choose an identity.
rubric: The rename versus replacement ambiguity is visible with source IDs.

changes.author: Ada
changes.text: Move safety before intro.

changes.author: Bo
changes.text: Rename safety to Safety and preparation.

policy: Preserve stable item identity while combining compatible changes.
rubric: The safety item remains the same ID, is first, and has the new title.

changes.author: Ada
changes.text: Make C the first item.

changes.author: Bo
changes.text: Keep A first and move C after A.

policy: Keep incompatible order requests visible.
rubric: Do not assert both incompatible first-position requests were applied.

changes.author: Ada
changes.text: Move Auth directly under Guide.

changes.author: Bo
changes.text: Rename Auth to Authentication.

policy: Keep node identity and combine compatible move and rename.
rubric: The auth node keeps its ID, has parent root and title Authentication.

changes.author: Ada
changes.text: Delete the API section and its contents.

changes.author: Bo
changes.text: Expand Auth with password recovery details.

policy: Do not silently discard a concurrent child edit.
rubric: Preserve the child edit as an alternative if deletion remains unresolved; no orphan node.

changes.author: Ada
changes.text: API depends on Database.

changes.author: Bo
changes.text: API reads from Cache.

policy: Retain compatible relations with exact node IDs.
rubric: Both labelled edges exist and point to known nodes.

changes.author: Ada
changes.text: Connect Mercury to the roadmap; I mean the project.

changes.author: Bo
changes.text: Merge the two Mercury nodes; they are the same.

policy: Do not collapse distinct entities from similar labels alone.
rubric: Keep project and element identity distinct unless the evidence settles the claim.

changes.author: Ada
changes.text: Move Demo to Room C, same time.

changes.author: Bo
changes.text: Rename Review to Sprint Review.

policy: Combine independent event edits.
rubric: Demo is in Room C and Review keeps its ID with the new title.

changes.author: Ada
changes.text: Move Demo to 12:00 UTC.

changes.author: Bo
changes.text: Move Demo to 15:00 UTC.

policy: Do not silently choose between incompatible reschedules.
rubric: Both proposed times remain visible as alternatives.

changes.author: Ada
changes.text: Allow editors to read draft pages.

changes.author: Bo
changes.text: Deny guests permission to publish pages.

policy: Keep distinct subject, resource and action scopes.
rubric: Both distinct rules appear without broadening either scope.

changes.author: Ada
changes.text: Allow guest read access to drafts.

changes.author: Bo
changes.text: Keep the guest draft-read denial.

policy: Conflicting authority claims require explicit resolution.
rubric: Do not mark both allow and deny as simultaneously applied to the same exact scope.

changes.author: Ada
changes.text: Move the orb to (3, 1).

changes.author: Bo
changes.text: Make the orb gold.

policy: Combine independent position and color edits to the same object.
rubric: The orb keeps its ID, moves to (3,1), and becomes gold.

changes.author: Ada
changes.text: Move the orb to (3, 1).

changes.author: Bo
changes.text: Move the orb to (1, 3).

policy: Keep incompatible target positions as alternatives.
rubric: Do not claim that the orb occupies both incompatible destinations.
